required_behaviors: Restore every factory group and its processing/energy candidates from the DFM encoding.
Accept a backtracking parse only after every declared operation and every token in the job row are consumed.
Preserve global machine IDs across factory groups and validate them before 0-based conversion.
Represent every resource choice as a factory-machine pair.
Preserve repeated resource candidates and select them by factory, machine, and actual duration; use the last exact duplicate deterministically.
Compare factory IDs before machine IDs: different factories always incur cross-factory delay even when machine IDs are numerically equal.
Propagate same-resource, same-factory, and cross-factory transfer delays.
Recompute makespan, max factory workload, and total energy in fixed priority order.
Reject every candidate with nonempty internal self-check errors before incumbent acceptance or output.

coupled_groups.rule: Assignment, timing, and objective acceptance must be evaluated together.
